source: Decision A11: the user delegated the three premises to Claude on 2026-09-30 ("3 cool and creative wizard fantasy premises"); committed before any measured run (overview rule 4).

premises.text: A cartographer's apprentice learns that the map she is inking redraws the kingdom each night, and three noble houses will kill to hold her pen.
In a city where debts are paid in years of memory, a pawnbroker of forgotten days is hired to recover the queen's stolen childhood.
A dragon too old to fly hires a crew of thieves to steal its own hoard back from the knights who claim to have slain it.

W1.measure: steps whose call parsed and validated on the first try / all steps, per route

W2.measure: finished stories whose final draft passes parseStoryV2 with 0 errors / finished stories

W3.measure: accepted / proposed writes over the 3 premises (refused calls are not proposals)

W4.measure: each generated story plays 30 turns on a lane with >= 2 transitions and no stall

W6.measure: blind-rating pack: agent story preferred over the staged wizard's on the same premise
